description: This Java source file defines the RetrieveFeaturesResponse class, representing the response to a RetrieveFeatures command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from various inputs (JSON string, JSON object, ThingId), as well as serialization/deserialization logic. The class encapsulates details about the ThingId and Features retrieved, and provides mechanisms for JSON representation and comparison.
